canonical_project: Okestro Cloud Sejong Finance Center II data center
notes: Sejong and Okestro Cloud signed a 2025 MOU for a KRW 700 billion data center in the vacant Sejong Finance Center II building, with reports citing up to 40 MW and a 2027 target. A 2026 local report says the plan was scrapped, so current status is recorded as rejected/cancelled.
